newsitem.title: USA: Food Lion extends Kash n' Karry offer.
newsitem.headline: Food Lion extends Kash n' Karry offer.

text.p: Food Lion Inc said on Friday it will extend until December 17 its $26 per share cash tender offer for the acquisition of shares of Kash n' Karry Food Stores Inc, which was begun on November 15.
The tender offer had been previously scheduled to expire on December 13, 1996.

The company said that on December 13, about 4,625,798 shares of Kash n' Karry's common stock had been validly tendered in the offer and not withdrawn, of which 20,250 shares were tendered pursuant to notices of guaranteed delivery.
The tendered shares constitute about 98.9 percent of Kash n' Karry outstanding common stock, the company said.
The company said that the merger could be effected without the necessity of a Kash n' Karry stockholder vote if more than 90 percent of Kash n' Karry's outstanding shares are acquired in the offer.
